The first thing I notice is cleanliness. Urja Unlimited is well-maintained gym, smell fresh, have spotless floors, and well maintained equipments.

I met Sudam Sir, about 1.5 years ago. I have struggled with weight and lack of mobility for a long time. I have a chronic slip disc at 2 places. Am also, restricted from having any pain killers and anti biotics.
My asks of him haven't been extreme weight loss or muscle tone, it has been simple, I should be able to walk 5 KM non-stop and climb 7 flights of stairs, again non-stop.
He first understood my body type, its range of movement and its restrictions. Then more importantly he understood my mental make up. He modulated the training routine accordingly. It is mixed with muscle stretches, pain releiving traction, yoga, aerobics and weight training. He also does accu-pressure and stress releiving alternate therapies such as gong therapy. He forces nothing, we try and then keep what works and drop what does not.
His training has given me the cofidence to travel, knowing that I can manage the pain and more importantly function more efficiently on a day-to-day basis, being able to move more efficiently and knowing what to do to releive my muscle and bone related pain, if an episode was to occur.
I do believe that he is different, not just interested in taking me through a routine, but interested in my overall well being through exercise, diet, therapy and motivation.
Thank you Sudam Sir
